content: RKS approach has been used in the articles for NLP tasks [29,30,23]. In this work, we use RKS to imporve the evaluation scores as discussed previously. The RKS approach explicitly maps the embedding vectors to a dimension where the data becomes linearly separable. In that space, regularized least-square based classification (RLSC) is performed. The implementation of the RKS is taken from BIBREF29, BIBREF30. The feature vectors from Google universal sentence encoder and fasttext are explicitly mapped using RKS and the results are tabulated in Table TABREF27 and TABREF28.
